title: SPQM
description: Create based modpack for the Senatus Populusque Minecraft server.
body:
SPQM is a modpack centered on the create mod, with many optimisation and QoL mods to ensure a smooth experience. Alongside the create mod the pack also features some of its addons and other popular mods, like farmers delight.
The pack is a nice collection of popular and lesser known mods in addition to essential performance mods to create a fun experience for every player. 

The modpack is primarily made for a private server with me and my friends, though you can use it for yourself, ofcourse.
